items.prompt: Why avoid using raw sizeof(struct) bytes as the portable file schema?

options.text: Every C++ object has no padding
Native endian always matches every network format
options.why: An explicit format must declare its byte order.
It does not provide those protocol semantics.

options.text: Layout and padding are not a declared cross-platform format
options.why: Serialize validated fields into explicit bytes instead.

items.explanation: Object representation rules do not define a stable external protocol or business interpretation.
